title: Stability of reachable-code counts
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be a language of binary strings, let $sp:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a binary input. Suppose $N$ decides $L$ using space bound $sp$, and suppose $sp(|x|)\le s$ for some natural number $s$. Then the numbers of reachable configuration codes in windows $s$ and $s+1$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Finite-state nondeterministic machine $N$ over binary alphabet
